description: Create a new live stream event. Trial accounts cannot create lives. A quality_package above the plan's maximum is silently lowered to the plan's maximum. Without stream_key_id the account's default stream key is used; a key held by another live (online, provisioning, expired, waiting to start or scheduled within 24h) returns 400. Omitted fields use the API defaults (region us, save_vod true).

quality_package.description: Quality package: sd, hd, fhd (Full HD) or 4k

region.description: Broadcast region: us (USA) or br (Brazil, lower delay for viewers in Brazil)

save_vod.description: Save the recording as a video when the live ends (default true)

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]. Without a zone it is Brasília time (UTC-3); add Z or ±HH:MM when the user is elsewhere.

stream_key_id.description: Stream key ID (panda_list_stream_keys); default key when omitted

name: panda_create_live
title: Create Live
